newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes firmer on dollar supply.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes firmer on dollar supply.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed firmer at 43.2920/2980 to the dollar in an active interbank session on Thursday against the previous close at 43.2950/3000, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted firmer at 43.2950/2980 per dollar in early trade but gained further as nationalised banks made increased selling offers of the U.S. currency.
"There were demands (of dollar) but liquidity too. It was a very active session," said one dealer with a foreign bank.
The call money was traded at 6.0 to 6.25 percent, slightly down from the previous 6.0-6.5 percent.
